title: Kitchen Appliances: Air Fryers
publisher: University of Illinois Extension (College of ACES)
tips_text: Preheat: Follow the instruction manual — but typically preheat for 3 minutes.
In the middle of cooking time, shake fryer basket or use tongs to flip foods.
Do not overcrowd the basket; this can prevent food from cooking evenly.
Avoid flipping basket to remove food as oil in the bottom drawer may spill and cover the food.
Use oils with high smoke points. Examples include peanut, safflower, grapeseed, and olive oils, excluding virgin or extra virgin olive oils.
Set air fryer temperature to 350 F and cook until food reaches internal temperature of 165 F.
